state:
**Goal `ext-grants` — a guest reaches only the files and hosts all three parties grant — Stage 4 (files) is written; Stage 5 (outbound HTTP) is next.** M9. No floor is carried: the suites, the `.nvst` trees and `nv verify` are the safety net, and goals `ext-host` and `ext-compiler`'s tests stay green as tests of the tree.

The design is ADR 0246 § 7 and the user's, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets. No record slot: a question the record leaves is settled under AGENTS.md's priority ordering and written in the module doc of the file that answers it.

**On disk:** `nvs_ext::load::Entry` and `Extension` carry the entry's `Granted`, which `nvs_cli::extensions::entry` fills from `nvs_config::extension::grants`. `Budget::caller` (default: holds nothing) names the caller; `nvs_cli::extensions::Spent` answers it from the snapshot's `[capabilities]` and the creating context's `Ctx::grant_filter`. `Request::instantiate` asks `grants::effective` once per instance and hands the `Effective` to `wasi::Context::new`. `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi/files.rs` is the real `wasi:filesystem`: one preopen per root, a path resolved one name at a time through `nvs_config::capability::resolved` and prefix-checked against the descriptor's root; its module doc owns the semantics. Tests: `crates/nvs-ext/tests/files.rs` (the symlink case skips on Windows without the privilege; proved under WSL).

**Still open:** `Effective.connect` is computed and dropped — `wasi:http` is not linked, so no guest reaches a host. Monotonic subscriptions are `Ready` at once.

items.text: **An outbound door on the budget** — `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:98` (`Budget`) gains a method that sends one request and returns its response, so this crate does not link `nvs-stdlib`; `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:380` (`impl Budget for Spent`) answers it through `Core\Http\Client`'s transport, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/http/transport.rs:1239` (`send`), so the address policy, TLS trust and the proxy apply. `rule:packaging/a-guest-has-no-ambient-authority`.

**`wasi:http` linked, narrowed to `Effective.connect`** — add `wasi:http/types` and `wasi:http/outgoing-handler` to `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs:97` (`LINKED`) and `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs:176` (`link`), keep `crates/nvs-ext/src/grants.rs:81` (`Effective::connect`) in `wasi::Context` beside `preopens`, and refuse a host outside it before the budget's door is called. Tests in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/http.rs`, named by `bun nv loop --list --stage 5`. `rule:security/extension-grants-are-an-intersection`.

backlog: Stage 6: the attacks and examples under `tools:config/extension-grants-what-a-component-may-reach`, and the `nvs-cli` reload test (`bun nv loop --list --stage 6`).
`nvs:tools/nv/test/html-later-polyfill.test.ts` was red on the last sweep as a selection miss, not from this goal's files — check it is still red before touching it.
